The '''Ossus Keepers''' maintained the protected archives in the [[Hall of Knowledge/Legends|Hall of Knowledge]] of the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] that was located on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. These individuals also acted as references to those that desired a more interactive solution to their problems.

==Behind the scenes==
The Ossus Keeper is mentioned in the backstory for the [[Ossus Keeper robe]]s item in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''.
